name: cb2-nokey-cancel
_comment: confirm-B2 probe (C1): CHIRPSTACK_API_KEY empty on both sides; record with OSI_ORACLE_NODE=edge/harness/scenarios/dispatch/oracle-nokey-node.sh and replay with a Go wrapper that runs `exec env CHIRPSTACK_API_KEY= <osi-edge> "$@"`. cancel-ingress builds the ChirpStack client (transport: cs()) before cancelActuation, and its constructor throws on an empty key, so Node-RED writes nothing and answers 500 with the constructor's message. Conditional opens whose transport shows no send (INTENT, enqueue_rejected), a conditional ACCEPTED open, and an ordinary ACCEPTED open.
